```{r}
# 1. LOAD LIBRARY
library(readxl)
library(urca)
library(lmtest)

# 2. PERSIAPAN DATA
data <- read_excel("D:/STIS/ARW/UAS/DATA UAS_222413767.xlsx", sheet = "no3")
C <- ts(data$konsumsi, start = c(2010, 1), frequency = 4)   # Konsumsi RT
Y <- ts(data$pdb,      start = c(2010, 1), frequency = 4)   # PDB
plot(cbind(Konsumsi = C, PDB = Y), main = "Konsumsi RT dan PDB Indonesia")

# 3. UJI STASIONERITAS (H0: tidak stasioner)
# asli
summary(ur.df(C, type = "trend", lags = 4, selectlags = "AIC"))
summary(ur.df(Y, type = "trend", lags = 4, selectlags = "AIC"))
# diff
summary(ur.df(diff(C), type = "drift", lags = 4, selectlags = "AIC"))
summary(ur.df(diff(Y), type = "drift", lags = 4, selectlags = "AIC"))

# 4. PERSAMAAN JANGKA PANJANG
model_jp <- lm(C ~ Y)
summary(model_jp)

# 5. UJI KOINTEGRASI ENGLE-GRANGER
ect <- ts(residuals(model_jp), start = c(2010, 1), frequency = 4)
summary(ur.df(ect, type = "none", lags = 1))

# 6. ERROR CORRECTION MODEL (lag 1 dan lag 4 untuk pola triwulanan)
dC <- diff(C); dY <- diff(Y)
dat <- data.frame(ts.intersect(dC = dC, dY = dY, ECT_1 = lag(ect, -1),
                               dC_1 = lag(dC, -1), dC_4 = lag(dC, -4),
                               dY_1 = lag(dY, -1), dY_4 = lag(dY, -4)))
model_ecm <- lm(dC ~ ., data = dat)
summary(model_ecm)

# 7. UJI DIAGNOSTIK
bgtest(model_ecm, order = 4)   # H0: tidak ada autokorelasi
bptest(model_ecm)              # H0: homoskedastis
```
